provenance.scope: Full pretrained DeiT-tiny image classification. All 12 blocks, complete attention head 1, labeled activation slices. The deterministic shapes image is deliberately synthetic and ImageNet predictions are not ground-truth shape labels.

image.alt: A red circle, a blue square and a green triangle on white.
image.source: Deterministic synthetic geometric input generated by scripts/capture-multimodal.py

predictions.label: punching bag, punch bag, punching ball, punchball

operations.label: 16 × 16 image patches
operations.description: The image processor resizes to 224 × 224 and normalizes RGB channels. A learned convolution projects each 16 × 16 RGB patch (768 pixel values) into a 192D token. All 196 patches participate.

operations.label: [CLS] + position embeddings
operations.description: A learned class token is prepended to the patch sequence, then learned position embeddings are added. Attention receives 197 tokens.

operations.label: Bidirectional self-attention
operations.description: The class token and every patch attend to the entire image. This is the full recorded first head; no causal mask is applied.

operations.label: Dense GELU feed-forward
operations.description: The same 192 → 768 → 192 MLP acts independently on each token. LayerNorm and residual paths surround the attention and MLP sublayers.
operations.formula: MLP(x) = W₂ GELU(W₁ x + b₁) + b₂

operations.label: Read the final [CLS] token
operations.description: After all 12 encoder blocks and final LayerNorm, only the class token is sent to the classifier. This is the full model’s final class token, independent of the selected intermediate block.

operations.label: ImageNet class probabilities
operations.description: These are actual predictions for the synthetic shapes image. ImageNet classes describe natural objects, so they are not ground-truth shape labels.

tensors.name: Top 8 class probabilities
rowLabels: punching bag, punch bag, punching ball, punchball
